text:
```yaml
name: AI Moderator

on:
  issues:
    types: [opened]
  issue_comment:
    types: [created]

jobs:
  ai-moderator:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    permissions:
      issues: write
      pull-requests: write
    steps:
      - name: Run AI Moderator
        uses: github/ai-moderator@v1
        with:
          model: gpt-4o-mini
          spam-detection: true
          ai-generated-detection: true
          spam-label: spam
          ai-generated-label: ai-generated
          comment-minimization: true
```
